name: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber
short: Google DeepMind's security fine-tune of 3.8 Flash for vuln-patching; CWE-Bench 47.2%, Fairwind-gated, Google-only.
modalities: Text, code in; text, code out
standout: Google’s purpose-tuned vulnerability-patching model — a security fine-tune of 3.8 Flash made specifically for finding and fixing exploitable code.
tradeoff: Hard-gated distribution: Fairwind access and Google-only availability make it a specialist tool for vetted security teams, not an everyday API.
